newsitem.title: FINLAND: AKTIA BANK EXPECTS GOOD END-1996 PROFIT TREND.
newsitem.headline: AKTIA BANK EXPECTS GOOD END-1996 PROFIT TREND.

text.p: Aktia Saastopankki Oy said in a statement on Thursday it expected its profit trend to remain good throughout this year.
"Aktia's nine-month earnings improvement is satisfactory and we expect the good trend to continue until the end of the year," Aktia said in its January-September report.

Following a share issue in August, Aktia said its capital base was stable and this would make it possible for the bank "to grow also in the future." It repeated its expansion plans in the Tampere and Keski-Uusimaa regions.
At end-September, Aktia's capital adequacy (BIS) was 12.8 percent, up from 10.0 percent at end-1995.
Aktia's operating profit after credit losses surged 81.6 percent to 34.5 million markka and net profit rose 37.4 percent to 26.1 million markka.
"The profit rise was mainly due to the growth in lending and to increasing other income," Aktia said.
Lending to the public rose 8.5 percent and deposits from the public rose 5.3 percent.
In January-September, Aktia's total income rose 7.5 percent to 337.2 million markka.
